params.source:
# HALO — a ring-wing tail-sitter drone (concept, generation 1)
# No arms, no exposed props, no landing gear: one annular wing is at once the rotor duct (hover),
# the wing (cruise, flying nose-first along +Z) and the landing ring. Inside it, two coaxial
# contra-rotating toroidal (closed-loop) rotors; the central pod holds a structural battery.
design halo units=mm

# --- driving parameters ---------------------------------------------------------------
param ringLe = 215          # radius of the ring-wing leading edge
param ringChord = 170       # ring-wing (duct) chord
param ringTe = 10           # height of the ring trailing edge (the landing ring)
param tipGap = 3            # rotor tip clearance to the duct wall (radial)
param hubR = 19             # radius where the rotor loops root into the pod (hub)
param loopChord = 24        # chord of the toroidal blade section
param loopTilt = 22         # loop-plane tilt from the rotor plane, deg (≈ blade arm pitch)
param zUpper = 140          # upper rotor plane
param zLower = 68           # lower rotor plane
param vaneChord = 42        # exit control vanes (also the four landing feet)
param podZ = 45             # pod shift forward (+Z = nose in cruise): puts the CG ahead of the ring-wing neutral point

# duct throat radius: NACA 4412 upper surface (inward) peaks at ≈ 0.098 c
param throatR = ringLe - 0.098*ringChord
param loopTipR = throatR - tipGap
param loopR = (loopTipR - hubR)/2 - loopChord/2       # centreline radius of one blade loop
param loopC = (loopTipR + hubR)/2                     # radial position of a loop centre

# --- materials: effective densities of the built-up parts (see README) -----------------
create_material _ name=ring_sandwich density=0.06 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#16181b" metalness=0.2 roughness=0.35 finish=carbon_twill clearcoat=1
create_material _ name=pod_packed density=1.5 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#e8e6e1" roughness=0.6
create_material _ name=rotor_foamcore density=0.45 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#c8553d" roughness=0.5
create_material _ name=vane_foamcore density=0.25 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#4a4f57" roughness=0.5
create_material _ name=sensor_dome density=1.6 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#3a6ea5" roughness=0.05

# --- ring wing / duct ------------------------------------------------------------------
# section drawn nose-down (camber faces the axis), revolved, then flipped so the inlet is on top
draw_naca_airfoil sec naca="4412" chord=ringChord incidenceDeg=-90 position=[ringLe, 0, 0] pointsPerSide=50
revolve_profile ring profileIds=[sec] axis="z" segments=128 rotation=[180deg, 0, 0] position=[0, 0, ringTe + ringChord] color="#1d2126"
assign_material _ materialName=ring_sandwich entityIds=[ring]

# --- centre pod: structural battery, coaxial motors, flight computer -------------------
revolve_profile pod axis="z" segments=64 position=[0, 0, podZ] color="#e8e6e1" profile=[[0,-58],[5,-45],[11,-20],[17,5],[22,25],[25,50],[27,80],[29,115],[30,150],[28,180],[22,205],[13,225],[0,238]]
add_sphere eye radius=13 position=[0, 0, podZ+232] color="#3a6ea5"
assign_material _ materialName=pod_packed entityIds=[pod]
assign_material _ materialName=sensor_dome entityIds=[eye]

# --- upper rotor: three toroidal loops ------------------------------------------------
draw_naca_airfoil s1 naca="0012" chord=loopChord position=[loopR-loopChord/2, 0, 0] pointsPerSide=24
revolve_profile loopA0 profileIds=[s1] axis="z" segments=64 position=[loopC, 0, zUpper] rotation=[loopTilt*pi/180, 0, 0] color="#c8553d"
assign_material _ materialName=rotor_foamcore entityIds=[loopA0]
array_polar loopsA id=loopA0 count=3 center=[0, 0, 0]

# --- lower rotor: four loops, opposite hand (3 vs 4 loops: co-prime, spreads the interaction tones)
draw_naca_airfoil s2 naca="0012" chord=loopChord position=[loopR-loopChord/2, 0, 0] pointsPerSide=24
revolve_profile loopB0 profileIds=[s2] axis="z" segments=64 position=[loopC, 0, zLower] rotation=[-loopTilt*pi/180, 0, 0] color="#d98a3a"
assign_material _ materialName=rotor_foamcore entityIds=[loopB0]
array_polar loopsB id=loopB0 count=4 center=[0, 0, 0]

# --- exit vanes: thrust vectoring in hover, elevons in cruise, feet on the ground ------
draw_naca_airfoil vs naca="0010" chord=vaneChord pointsPerSide=24
extrude_profile vane0 id=vs depth=ringLe axis=[1, 0, 0] color="#4a4f57"
assign_material _ materialName=vane_foamcore entityIds=[vane0]
move_entities _ ids=[vane0] delta=[0, 0, ringTe+12]
array_polar vanes id=vane0 count=4 center=[0, 0, 0] angle=2*pi

# --- joints: what is bonded to what (rotor hubs turn on bearings in the pod, not modelled) ---
set_part_grounded _ ids=[ring] grounded=true      # airframe datum
allow_interference _ a=vane0 b=ring kind=weld reason="vane tip bonded into the ring trailing edge"
allow_interference _ a=vanes[0] b=ring kind=weld reason="vane tip bonded into the ring trailing edge"
allow_interference _ a=vanes[1] b=ring kind=weld reason="vane tip bonded into the ring trailing edge"
allow_interference _ a=vanes[2] b=ring kind=weld reason="vane tip bonded into the ring trailing edge"
allow_interference _ a=vane0 b=vanes[0] kind=weld reason="cruciform vane root"
allow_interference _ a=vanes[0] b=vanes[1] kind=weld reason="cruciform vane root"
allow_interference _ a=vanes[1] b=vanes[2] kind=weld reason="cruciform vane root"
allow_interference _ a=vanes[2] b=vane0 kind=weld reason="cruciform vane root"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=vane0 kind=weld reason="pod tail cone carried by the vane cross"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=vanes[0] kind=weld reason="pod tail cone carried by the vane cross"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=vanes[1] kind=weld reason="pod tail cone carried by the vane cross"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=vanes[2] kind=weld reason="pod tail cone carried by the vane cross"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=eye kind=weld reason="sensor dome bonded in the nose"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=loopA0 kind=weld reason="loop root in the upper rotor hub (hub bearing not modelled)"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=loopsA[0] kind=weld reason="loop root in the upper rotor hub (hub bearing not modelled)"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=loopsA[1] kind=weld reason="loop root in the upper rotor hub (hub bearing not modelled)"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=loopB0 kind=weld reason="loop root in the lower rotor hub (hub bearing not modelled)"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=loopsB[0] kind=weld reason="loop root in the lower rotor hub (hub bearing not modelled)"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=loopsB[1] kind=weld reason="loop root in the lower rotor hub (hub bearing not modelled)"
allow_interference _ a=pod b=loopsB[2] kind=weld reason="loop root in the lower rotor hub (hub bearing not modelled)"

# --- checks: geometry, clearances, mass, aerodynamics --------------------------------
check bbox of=ring expect ~= [2*219.93, 2*219.93, ringChord] ± 0.5%
check max of=loopA0 path=0 expect <= throatR-tipGap+0.5
check check_assembly clearanceMm=2 thickness=off path=status expect == "pass"   # no rotor within 2 mm of duct, vanes or the other rotor
check mass of=pod expect ~= 720g ± 5%
check mass of=ring expect <= 200g
check analyze_airfoil naca="4412" alphasDeg=[0,4] path=zeroLiftAngleDeg expect ~= -4.3 ± 0.1
check standard_atmosphere altitude=0 path=densityKgM3 expect ~= 1.225
